step1_analysis.description: A fully differential preamplifier used in the sub-ADC of a pipelined ADC. It amplifies the difference between the differential input signal and the differential reference voltage.

paper_reference.title: A 15-b 40-MS/s CMOS Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter With Digital Background Calibration

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the preamplifier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the provided VB1=0.54V bias and SKY130 NMOS parameters. Much lower than the paper's 370mW which is for the entire ADC.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_in = 2 * Id / Vov = 2 * 9.7uA / 0.084V = 230 uS. gm_load = 2 * 19.4uA / 0.278V = 139 uS. Base Gain = gm_in / gm_load ~ 1.65 V/V = 4.3 dB. With partial positive feedback from XM9, gain is slightly boosted.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Preamplifiers in flash sub-ADCs typically have low gain (2-10 V/V) to maximize bandwidth. The 73.5 dB reported in the paper is for the main op-amp, not this preamplifier.

ugbw.description: Unity gain bandwidth of the preamplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bandwidth is determined by the output pole: f_p = gm_load / (2 * pi * C_load). Assuming C_load ~ 10fF (parasitic), f_p = 139uS / (2 * pi * 10fF) = 2.2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Needs to be fast enough to settle within a fraction of the 40 MHz clock period (25 ns).

sys_offset.description: Systematic output offset voltage (VAN - VAP) at zero differential input.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM9 supplies current to VAN, but XM10 is connected as a dummy (D=VDD) instead of supplying VAP. This asymmetry causes VAN to rise to ~1.38V to turn off XM7, while VAP stays at ~1.1V. Offset = 1.38 - 1.1 = 0.28V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the asymmetric cross-coupled load in the provided netlist (likely an extraction artifact from the original schematic).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, systematic offset, AC differential gain, unity gain bandwidth, and transient response of the comparator preamplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Comparator Preamplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 VAP VIP N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 VAN VAN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM9 VAN VAP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM2 VAP VIN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 N2 VB1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 VAP VAP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM3 VAN VRP N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VAN VRN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 N3 VB1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM10 VDD VAN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVB1 VB1 0 0.54

VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.8 1.0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 10n)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.0 0.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 10n)
VVRP VRP 0 DC 0.9
VVRN VRN 0 DC 0.9

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let vout_sys_offset = v(VAN) - v(VAP)
  print power
  print vout_sys_offset

  ac dec 20 1Meg 10Gig
  let vout_diff = v(VAP) - v(VAN)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(vout_diff))
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1

  tran 0.1n 20n
  meas tran vap_max max v(VAP)
  meas tran vap_min min v(VAP)
  meas tran van_max max v(VAN)
  meas tran van_min min v(VAN)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
